overview: Across 33 papers, simulation-based inference and flow matching dominate LISA gravitational-wave and strong-lens posterior work, including Euclid DR1/Q1 lens searches and spinning EMRIs. Cosmological emulators use 3D U-Nets and graph networks for Lyman-alpha forests, hot gas and filaments. Foundation models and agents appear in Rubin-Euclid source detection, radio analysis and IceCube neutrino searches.
themes: Simulation-based inference for LISA and gravitational waves
Euclid strong-lens finding and agentic modeling
Foundation models and LLM agents for astronomy workflows
Cosmological emulation and generative field reconstruction
